There is no timeframe on when the entire collection will be complete as it can forever be random and change . EPISODE 04: Chroma World Loyalties & Rewards Program is deployed. This is about rewarding the loyal community members & those who HODL Abstractars. The finer details of this will be explained shortly after we launch the collection.
